title: question_form finds its install folder through shared_names.install_root alone, and the use_hooks_home lookup goes
why: Lane bg-tail-loses-verdict (session_013NEJL3ZjZdzrS8tBezxY85), 16:58 CST Nov 8; Merge after: #2321 (step hooks-home-lookups). shared_names.install_root(HERE) already finds lint/ from a stamped guard.d/<id>/ copy, so question_form's use_hooks_home call and its told-folder lookup install_path are a second lookup for one job (rule building-one-home-per-capability). #2321 keeps both, with the reason in its record: a builder tried the merge there and the mutant survived (its diff is in that lane's scratchpad, qfmut-b7e1/f2.diff). Fix: remove the use_hooks_home call in guard.py and its refusal path; make install_path use install_root; swap the mutant "copy is not told its install folder" in hooks/mutate_guard.py for one on install_root, and update its test mention; rewrite decision install-hooks-whole lines 13 and 17. A test-author goes before the builder.
note: Wording fixes from the #2321 reviews (lane 17:09 CST Nov 8), for the same record lines: (a) the override.py bullet in decision install-hooks-whole says a copy's override read fails and "the refusal stands with no override lifted"; wrong, since override.take already lifted the refusal from a copy on the base, and #2321 fixes only the owner-text lookup (_text_of). (b) The _print_crash_deny text says the guard "refuses every call, Bash and PowerShell too"; the question_form path refuses only ArtifactData and Artifact-publish calls. (c) Record line 13 should say "the PreToolUse guard does not reach decision_watch"; the local_time, override, call_judge path reaches it lazily. From the fresh round 3 on #2301 and #2321 (lane bg-tail-loses-verdict, reviewer sonnet, 01:24 CST Nov 9; both pass, net value positive; all on #2321's head aa8bdac0e; notes, none likely in normal work): (d) docs/decisions/install-hooks-whole.md:12 cites "guard-hooks-fail-closed item 13", but that decision has no numbered items; cite its "Advisory hooks stay fail-open" bullet by id. (e) Same record, line 14: "The guard does not reach the other three" is wrong for decision_watch (override.py:435/449, call_judge.py:258/279), and precompact_handoff.py:499 reaches feedback_guard and then ruling_home; this restates (c). (f) docs/debts/notes.md:760, note question-form-import-fails-open: after #2321 the guard refuses as guard-crash, so only the chat-judge half stays true. (g) hooks/guard.py:375 `_question_form_module` text overstates "refuses every call"; this restates (b). Do these after #2321 merges.
